app_department: Division of Occupational and Environmental Diseases, Department of Disease Control
requester_gate_notice: Every request is approved by a named officer before the system fetches any data.
requester_response_promise: A decision is sent within 24 business hours. The data file is delivered by email only and never shown on this website.
requester_no_reason_notice: If your request is not approved, you will be told only that it was not approved. No reason is given.
requester_telephone_request: Please give a telephone number you answer. An officer may call to confirm who you are before deciding.
requester_deid_column_count: 23 columns, the same for every request
requester_deid_lead: The file has no patient names in it. That is the correct result, not a broken file.
requester_deid_included_1: Report code, ICD-10 code and the diagnosis list
requester_deid_included_2: Birth date, age at onset, gender, title and nationality
requester_deid_included_5: Province and district where the case was investigated, and that province's health region
requester_deid_included_7: Onset, treatment, diagnosis, death, report and last-updated dates
requester_deid_excluded_1: Names, surnames and national ID numbers
requester_deid_excluded_2: Addresses, house numbers, roads and villages
requester_deid_excluded_3: Sub-district or finer. District is the smallest area named.
requester_deid_excluded_6: Any contact detail of a case
requester_deid_allowlist_note: This column list is fixed. A reviewing officer cannot add a column for an individual request. Every file ships with a Thai and English data dictionary.
requester_email_warning: The download link goes to this address and nowhere else. The system does not check that the address is correct or that it exists. If you mistype it, nobody will know and the file will not reach you.
requester_retention_notice: Your contact details and the record of your request are kept indefinitely, so that every data release stays traceable to who asked and who approved.
requester_dates_hint: The first and last day are both included
requester_span_cap_notice: A date range can be at most 365 days. This is a limit of the Department of Disease Control API. If you need more, please send more than one request. The system will not split the range for you.
requester_area_hint: Optional. Leaving it blank means the whole country.
requester_area_region_expansion: This request will be stored as the following {count} provinces, not as a region number.
requester_province_region_hint: {province} is in health region {region}. It is shown on the map only so you can see where it is.
requester_province_single_note: This request will store {province} only. It is not expanded to the whole region. You may choose one province at a time.
requester_contact_lead: The reviewing officer uses this to judge who you are and whether you really work where you say. The system does not check or verify anything in this section.
requester_workplace_note: Free text. There is no list to choose from and the system checks it against no register. Please write it clearly enough that the reviewing officer recognises your workplace.
requester_submit_note: Nothing is sent yet. You will check everything once more before sending.
error_span_too_long_title: That date range is longer than you can ask for
error_span_too_long_detail: The Department of Disease Control API limits one request to 365 days. The system will not split the range for you, because then you would not know whether you had received everything. Please send more than one request.
error_incomplete_title: Cannot send yet. {count} items are missing.
error_incomplete_hint: Select an item to jump to that field. Everything you have already filled in is kept.
error_email_required: Please enter an email address. The system delivers the file by email only.
requester_confirm_lead: Your request is in the queue for review. There is nothing more for you to do.
requester_confirm_keep_number: Please keep this number. The system does not send a confirmation email. If you close this page you will see the number again in the email telling you the decision.
requester_confirm_decision_detail: Sent by email within 24 business hours. An officer may telephone you to confirm who you are before deciding.
requester_confirm_approved_detail: The system emails a download link to the address you gave. The link lasts 72 hours from the moment the file is ready.
requester_confirm_contact: If you have a question about this request, call {telephone} and quote the reference number.
requester_duplicate_title: A request from this network is already in progress
requester_duplicate_lead: It may be your own request, or a colleague's on the same office internet connection. The system will not accept a new request from this network until that one has a decision.
requester_collect_deleted_after: After that the file is deleted from the system.
requester_collect_zip_detail: A CSV of de-identified case-level data, and a Thai and English data dictionary describing every column. The dictionary is the same in every request.
requester_collect_no_forward_detail: The link is the only credential. Anyone who opens it can download the file immediately, without signing in. If you need to share the data, send the file itself.
requester_collect_audited_detail: The system records the time, IP address and browser every time the download button is pressed, whether or not the download finishes. Opening this page does not count as a download, and nothing extends the 72 hours.
requester_collect_help: If the download fails or the file is damaged, call {telephone} and quote the reference number.
requester_expired_body: If you still need this data, please send a new request, or call {telephone}.
reviewer_signin_code: Six-digit code from your authenticator app
reviewer_signin_failed: The username, password or six-digit code is wrong.
reviewer_signin_no_lockout: You can try again immediately. The system does not lock accounts, but it waits longer after each failed attempt in a row.
reviewer_signin_audit_note: Every sign-in, and every failed sign-in, is recorded with the IP address and browser. The system does not record what you typed.
reviewer_signin_recovery_heading: Forgotten password, or a new authenticator device
reviewer_signin_recovery_detail: Contact the other reviewing officer. There is no email reset and no backup codes. Recovery is done on the server only.
reviewer_signin_unlisted_note: This page is not linked from the public site and is kept out of search engines. That is tidiness, not a security measure.
reviewer_queue_no_autorefresh: This page does not update itself. Email is the notification channel.
reviewer_inflight_suppression_note: A request listed under Needs attention is not shown again here.
reviewer_inflight_extracting_note: Nothing can be done until the extraction finishes.
reviewer_dossier_ahead: {count} requests are ahead of this one
reviewer_dossier_codes_disclosure: Show the {count} report codes this group covers
reviewer_probe_note: This number is not a reason to decide either way, and approving does not wait for it.
reviewer_probe_failed_note: The count is lost. The decision is not.
reviewer_clock_note: Business hours only, against the 24 business hour promise.
reviewer_judgement_identity: Does this person exist today, and do they work at the workplace they named? That is the only question to answer.
reviewer_judgement_size: How much data is asked for is not a reason to refuse. A large request is a slow request, not one that should be refused.
reviewer_judgement_uncertainty: If this screen cannot answer that question, telephone the requester before deciding, whether you intend to approve or not. Uncertainty is a call, never a rejection.
reviewer_decision_note: Approving cannot be undone, and your name stays on this data release permanently. A request that is too broad should be refused so the requester can narrow it and send again. An officer cannot edit a request on their behalf.
reviewer_approve_confirm_name: Your name, {reviewer}, stays on this data release permanently.
reviewer_approve_confirm_permanence: Everyone who reads this record in future will see that you vouched for who the requester is.
reviewer_approve_confirm_irreversible: When you confirm, extraction starts immediately and cannot be cancelled.
reviewer_reject_note_prompt: Please record the reason in the system. At least 10 characters.
reviewer_reject_note_private_heading: This note is never sent to the requester
reviewer_reject_note_private_detail: The decision email says only that the request was not approved. This note is here so that an officer in future can understand what happened.
reviewer_reject_no_autosave: The system does not save this as you type. A shared desk is the wrong place for this text to linger.
reviewer_reject_note_too_short: This note is too short. Please write at least 10 characters.
reviewer_decided_approved_detail: The requester will be emailed when the extract is ready. This request now appears on the In progress list.
reviewer_decided_rejected_detail: The requester was told only that the request was not approved. No reason was sent.
reviewer_decision_expired_heading: This request expired while you were reading it
reviewer_decision_expired_detail: It went 24 business hours without a decision before yours reached the server. It can no longer be approved or rejected.
reviewer_decision_gone: This request is no longer awaiting review. Someone else may have decided it, or it expired.
reviewer_decision_failed: The decision could not be recorded. Try again.
reviewer_alert_lapse_detail: The email was sent {hours} hours ago and the link has not been opened once. The system cannot see whether the email arrived, so all it knows is silence.
reviewer_alert_lapse_instruction: Please telephone the requester you vouched for, then choose what actually happened.
reviewer_alert_closed_set_note: These are the only choices. There is no free-text box. How often each outcome is chosen is the only measure the service has of how often this happens.
reviewer_contact_visible_note: Contact details stay visible for as long as the request is in progress, because chasing it needs this number.
reviewer_actions_heading: What can be done with this request
reviewer_resend_note: Resending sends the same link to the same address. It does not make a new file and it does not extend the 72 hours.
reviewer_rerun_note: Extracting again makes a new file, a new link and a fresh 72 hours. The old link is revoked only when the new file is ready, not when you press the button, and this is not a new decision.
reviewer_no_email_edit_heading: There is no button to correct the requester's email address, and there will not be one
reviewer_no_email_edit_detail: An officer decides who receives data, not where the data is sent. A requester who mistyped their address must send a new request and be reviewed again.
reviewer_empty_clear_detail: The desk is clear. You can sign out. The system will email you when a new request arrives.
reviewer_empty_clear_note: This page does not update itself. Leaving it open will not show you new requests any sooner.
reviewer_empty_alerts_kicker: Queue empty, but items are outstanding
reviewer_empty_alerts_title: No requests awaiting review, but {count} items need attention
reviewer_empty_alerts_detail: There are requests whose file was delivered but never downloaded, and requests whose extraction failed. Both are waiting for a person to make contact.
reviewer_empty_alerts_note: The work is not finished, even though the review queue is empty.
reviewer_session_warning_title: You will be asked to sign in again in 5 minutes
reviewer_session_warning_detail: One sign-in lasts at most 6 hours and cannot be extended. Any note you are part way through typing will be lost.
email_delivery_subject: The data for request {reference} is ready to download
email_delivery_body: Request {reference} has been approved and the data file is ready to download.
email_delivery_expiry_note: The link lasts 72 hours from the moment the file was ready. Opening it does not extend it. Once it expires the file is deleted and you must send a new request.
email_delivery_zip_note: The archive holds one CSV file and a Thai and English data dictionary. Please do not forward the link, because the link is the only credential.
email_rejection_no_reason: The system does not give a reason for the decision. You may send a new request at any time, and this outcome has no effect on a future request.
email_rejection_contact: If you have a question, call {telephone} and quote the reference number.
email_queue_subject: A new request is awaiting review: {reference}
email_queue_lead: A new request has joined the review queue.
email_queue_open: Open the queue to review it
email_queue_no_data_note: This email carries no patient data and no download link. Reviewing is possible only after signing in.
email_queue_notification_note: The queue page does not update itself. This email is the only notification channel.
email_failure_body: Request {reference}, which you approved, failed to extract. The system tried every time it was allowed and then stopped.
email_failure_requester_unaware: The requester has received nothing, and does not know about this.
email_failure_action_note: There is an item waiting on your queue page. You can either telephone the requester or ask the system to extract the data again.
email_failure_not_your_job_heading: You do not have to fix the technical fault
email_failure_not_your_job_detail: The system operator has been told separately. What is waiting for you is the promise made to the person you vouched for, not the broken job.
requester_check_lead: Nothing is sent yet. Please check every item, especially the email address, because it cannot be changed after sending.
requester_check_send_to: The file will be sent to
requester_check_send_to_warning: If this address is wrong, the file will not reach you, and once you send, neither you nor the reviewing officer can change it.
requester_check_edit_note: Everything you have filled in is kept when you go back to edit.
requester_duplicate_resent_heading: If you just pressed send twice or refreshed the page
requester_duplicate_resent_detail: Your first request was saved. There is no need to send again. Its reference number was on the page shown after sending, and will be in the decision email.
requester_duplicate_colleague_heading: If you have not sent a request
requester_duplicate_colleague_detail: The request in progress is probably a colleague's. You can send once it has a decision, or call {telephone} if you cannot wait.
reviewer_lookup_not_found: No request has that reference number.
reviewer_lookup_ended_title: This request has ended. Nothing more can be done.
reviewer_lookup_ended_detail: This page shows only what was recorded. The requester's contact details are not shown once a request has ended. If they need this data again, they send a new request.
reviewer_lookup_probe_at_decision: Approximate row count at the decision
reviewer_lookup_events_note: Newest first. Nothing in this record is edited or deleted; a correction is a new event citing the one it corrects.
reviewer_narrow_title: Please open this page on a computer
reviewer_narrow_detail: Reviewing a request needs a screen at least 1024 pixels wide, so the queue and the request can be seen together.
reviewer_narrow_desk: An approval puts your name on the release permanently, so it belongs at a desk, with a telephone free to call the requester.
requester_epidem_area_label: Filtered on the province that investigated the case
requester_epidem_area_detail: The filter uses the province the patient was living in when the case was surveyed. Not the registered address, and not the province of the treating hospital.
reviewer_idle_warning_title: You will be signed out in 5 minutes because nothing has happened
reviewer_idle_warning_detail: Press the button to carry on. Anything you are typing is kept.
reviewer_queue_refresh_stale: The list below is still from {minutes} minutes ago until it finishes loading.
reviewer_queue_refresh_failed_detail: The list below is from {minutes} minutes ago. You can reload it again.
reviewer_signin_throttled: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds, then try again.
reviewer_signin_unavailable: The service could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
reviewer_retention_heading: What is recorded about you, permanently
reviewer_retention_signins: Every sign-in and every failed sign-in, with the IP address and browser.
reviewer_retention_response_times: How long you take to respond, measured against the 24 business hour promise.
reviewer_retention_alerts: Every alert you clear and every alert left uncleared.
reviewer_retention_display_name: Your display name, on every decision you make.
reviewer_retention_permanent: All of this is kept indefinitely, so that every data release stays traceable and open to audit.
reviewer_first_login_detail: The password you were given at setup is temporary. Choose one that only you know before you continue.
reviewer_first_login_fresh_code: Wait for the code in your authenticator app to change, then enter the new one. The code you signed in with cannot be used again.
reviewer_password_rules: 12 to 20 characters, with at least one capital letter, one digit and one special character.
reviewer_password_failed: The current password or the six-digit code is wrong.
reviewer_password_violation_too_short: Too short: use at least 12 characters.
reviewer_password_violation_too_long: Too long: use at most 20 characters.
reviewer_password_violation_no_uppercase: Add at least one capital letter.
reviewer_password_violation_no_special: Add at least one special character, such as ! or ?.
reviewer_password_violation_same_as_curr: The new password must be different from the current one.
requester_submit_failed: The request may not have been sent. Please wait a moment and try again. If this message comes back, call {telephone}.
error_range_reversed: The last day is before the first day. Please check the dates.
reviewer_dossier_expired: This request went 24 business hours without a decision. It can no longer be approved or rejected.
reviewer_dossier_ahead_none: No requests are ahead of this one
reviewer_dossier_ahead_one: 1 request is ahead of this one
reviewer_dossier_none_selected: Pick a request from the list to read it.
reviewer_dossier_gone: This request is no longer awaiting review.
reviewer_dossier_load_failed: The request could not be loaded. Pick it again to retry.
reviewer_queue_load_failed: The list could not be loaded. You can try again.
